title: Instagram comments on a two-minute Diary of a CEO clip of Nate Soares
artefact_title: "Could AI become too smart for us to control?" (Diary of a CEO, @thediaryofaceopodcast with @nateasoares on Instagram, video, 2:09)
central_claim: Advanced AI could become impossible for humans to control and poses a serious risk, up to human extinction, that justifies slowing or stopping development.
capture_method: Manual copy and paste of the comment section from a logged-in Firefox session, finished 5 October 2026 at 09:19 UTC, rather than a browser extraction, so no like counts were captured. 77 of the 85 comments Instagram reported were retrieved. Publication dates are approximated from the relative time shown at capture.

spot_check.note: Pooled across the five DOAC studies: a random 347-row sample was coded a second time, blind, under codebook v2. Agreement: stance 317/347 (91.4%, kappa 0.87), frame 309/347 (89.0%, kappa 0.87), emotion 85.9%, format reaction 97.4%, mention flags 98.8%. Rows in the sample are marked spot_checked.

coders: Claude (claude-opus-5-5), parallel coders of about 190 comments each; rows first coded unclear, other or debater_verdict were recoded blind under codebook v2

changelog.note: First release. A first pass under codebook v1 fell just short of the 90% reliability bar on stance (88.2%) and frame (88.8%). Codebook v2 defined unclear against na and added tie-breaks for debater_verdict and other; every row coded unclear, other or debater_verdict across the five DOAC studies (14,993 of 26,019) was recoded blind under it.

Corrected the artefact. Version 1 described this post as the 104-second Diary of a CEO clip of Nate Soares, with an assumed post date of 17 September 2026. Checking the post showed it is a 2:09 clip led by Soares, published on 17 September 2026 (now verified), and the same cut as the TikTok post; the 104-second YouTube Short is a different video. Title, artefact_title and notes updated; the comments and their codes are unchanged.

licence: CC BY 4.0 (coding and compilation; comment text remains its authors')
notes: Rows flagged cta_keyword, emoji_only, no_text or featured_messenger were not sent to coders and carry stance na, frame other, emotion neutral and every flag false; exclude them from frame shares. debater_verdict is inflated by pile-on reply threads about Andrew McAfee: under the codebook, attacking the sceptic counts as agree, so one thread can add over a hundred agree rows. Weight by thread or report top-level comments separately before quoting agree or frame shares. Verified on 9 October 2026: the post is a 2:09 clip (128.96 seconds) led by Nate Soares, posted jointly by @thediaryofaceopodcast and @nateasoares with the caption "Could AI become too smart for us to control?…", published on 17 September 2026 at 20:00 UTC (decoded from the post ID). It is the same cut as the TikTok post in doac-clip-tiktok-2026-09 (2:08), not the 104-second YouTube Short.
